department: Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering (CEE)

deadline.value: Apply by December 15, 2026, 11:59 PM US Eastern (application opens September 15). ELP waiver requests close December 1; OGE fee-waiver requests are due December 1.
deadline.quote: Deadline: December 15 at 11:59 PM Eastern Time

gre_general.value: GRE is optional; if sent it is considered (scores within five years).
gre_general.quote: CEE will no longer require GRE scores, and sending GRE scores for consideration is optional.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

ielts_min.value: CEE requires IELTS Academic 7.5 overall, higher than MIT's general 7.
ielts_min.quote: International English Language Testing System (IELTS) Minimum score required: 7.5

also.quote: The minimum score for the IELTS is 7.5 on the Academic exam.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 100 (or 5 on the new band scale); Duolingo 135.

english_waiver.value: The CEE department site lists English-medium undergraduate education as grounds for a waiver (ticked in the application), but the OGE entry for CEE mentions only earlier qualifying scores; request it by December 1 and be ready to submit a score.
english_waiver.quote: you are required to take the Cambridge English, TOEFL, or IELTS exam unless: 1) English is your first language, or 2) English was the language of instruction for your undergraduate education

also.quote: applicants may request a waiver for the English language test requirement if you previously scored above the CEE minimum scores for TOEFL, DET, or IELTS prior to entering a graduate program in the US.

supervisor.value: Name the faculty you want to work with in your statement; CEE suggests asking your prospective faculty match about the GRE. Every CEE PhD student must have secured funding.
supervisor.quote: including the name(s) of faculty members with whom you would like to work. | You might consider asking your prospective faculty match if they have a preference.

funding.value: All students admitted to the SM/PhD track receive an RA or fellowship (tuition, health insurance, monthly stipend), depending on availability of funds.
funding.quote: All students admitted to the SM/PhD track receive Research Assistantships (RA) or Fellowships, depending on availability of such funds. | All students pursuing a Ph.D. in CEE must have secured funding.

entry_route.value: A bachelor's degree is required; admission is to the SM/PhD track.
entry_route.quote: All applicants to graduate programs in Civil and Environmental Engineering and the Interdepartmental Program in Transportation must hold a Bachelor’s degree.

notes: Covers civil and environmental engineering. Test scores must be verified by December 31, 2026; recommendation letters accepted until December 31.
